description: The VALUE-implied PICTURE clause (ISO §2023:13.16.3 SR9 for a data description entry, §2023:13.15.3 SR14 for a report group description entry - the SAME rule in the two general formats, and one gate) - 'The PICTURE clause may be omitted for an elementary item when an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal that is not a zero-length literal is specified in the data-item format of the VALUE clause', the implied clause being 'PICTURE X(length)' / '1(length)' / 'N(length)' with 'length ... as specified in 8.3.3, Literals'. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:VI.5.3.3 SR3 reads 'The PICTURE clause must be specified for every elementary item except an index data item and the subject of the RENAMES clause, in which case use of this clause is prohibited'; §2002:13.14.2 SR9 has the grant ('The PICTURE clause may be omitted for an elementary item when an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal is specified in the data-item format of the VALUE clause'), §2002:13.13.2 SR14 its report group twin, and §2002:F.2 item 96 states the change: 'The PICTURE clause may be omitted when the VALUE clause in a data description or report group description entry is specified with an alphanumeric, boolean or national literal.' §2014:13.16.2 SR9 and §2014:13.15.2 SR14 add the zero-length exclusion 2023 keeps, so 2014 = 2023. This row carries the rule's ALPHANUMERIC arm's introduction; SR9's boolean and national arms are gated a second time and independently by boolean-literal-2002 / national-literal-2002, since the literal forms themselves are 2002 additions. The figurative-constant spelling rides the same grant (§2023:8.3.3.1 makes a figurative constant a literal; §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 b/c supply the length, one character for a bare figurative and literal-1's length for ALL literal-1) - kb/Work PB828 the adjudication, PB504 the rule, PB831 the ALL-literal length.
